local-supervised-dogfood.description: Local, supervised, single-operator, non-sensitive dogfood (the RC2 dogfood boundary). Not a production claim.

production.description: Production readiness. Requires every runtime lane, including the external runtimes that are not validated today.

windows-native-e2e.description: scripts/dogfood/local_dogfood_e2e.py on Windows 11 with a private PostgreSQL cluster; evidence is E2E_RESULT.json.

vmware-linux-e2e.description: The same E2E on the VMware Linux VM (virt=vmware, never WSL), from a fresh online clone.
vmware-linux-e2e.notes: E2E_RESULT.json records the platform string, not the hypervisor; a WSL kernel string is refused, but VMware itself is attested only by the vm-summary of the ci-gates lane.

windows-ci-gates.description: The CI-required gates run natively on Windows by run_gates.ps1; evidence is its gate-summary.json. The registry fixes the complete gate list.
windows-ci-gates.notes: win_local_intel contains a pre-existing timing-sensitive test (R19-3); a run where it failed is FAIL, not PASS.

vmware-linux-ci-gates.description: The CI gate set on the VMware Linux VM, including the full deterministic suite with CI-provisioned databases and the wheel build.

postgres-integration.description: scripts/release/postgres_integration_gate.py, all suites, skips refused; evidence is its postgres-integration.json (schema v1) beside the per-suite reports it hashes.

github-ci.description: The required GitHub check runs for the exact commit; evidence is the unmodified GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/check-runs response.

windows-full-suite.notes: R19-3: 126 environment-dependent failures that are identical on pristine main. A baseline-identical run is recorded as FAIL with its comparison, never as PASS. Evidence is a gate summary of its own (run_gates.ps1 -Only full_pytest, gate-summary-partial.json); the ci-gates summary cannot back two lanes.

local-model-measured-execution.description: Stage B M2 -> M2.1/M3 (Windows and VMware) -> M4.1 live run of the pinned qwen3:8b artifact on local Ollama.
local-model-measured-execution.notes: PR #19: proves only the bounded measured-execution path that ran (receipt, schema validation, semantic_authority NONE).

local-model-governed-acceptance.description: Model output entering a ResultCandidate, human approval and the CAS.
local-model-governed-acceptance.notes: R19-6: the path does not exist by design (MODEL OUTPUT != TRUTH); the measured-execution lane never satisfies it.

rea-runtime.notes: PR #16 explicitly did not validate the real REA runtime.

openmaic-runtime.notes: PR #16 explicitly did not validate the real OpenMAIC runtime.

ai-scientist-v3-runtime.description: The AI-Scientist-v3 governed research pack real runtime.
ai-scientist-v3-runtime.notes: PR #17 is a draft and its real runtime is REAL_RUNTIME_NOT_VALIDATED.
